github.description: GitHub remote/hosted MCP at https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ (read-only path; remove /readonly for write mode). Auth: PAT via Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_PAT (fine-grained — Contents:Read, Pull Requests:Read+Write, Issues:Read+Write, Actions:Read, Metadata:Read, read:org, read:project, notifications). To use OAuth instead of PAT: delete the headers block; Claude Code will run the OAuth flow on first connect. For write mode (skills that post — review-pr, review-feedback, audit-pr postback): change /mcp/readonly → /mcp/ in the URL, or use the gh CLI fallback. See SETUP.md §4.1.

bitbucket.description: Bitbucket MCP via npx (npm package: bitbucket-mcp). Auth: $BITBUCKET_USERNAME + $BITBUCKET_TOKEN (workspace access token or app password). Surface: PR read/comment/approve, pipelines, branching model, repos. Sibling to the github MCP for teams that mirror or migrate between hosts. See SETUP.md §4.4.
